package.name: rammp_ui_bridge
package.description: Bridges an Unreal Engine touchscreen UI to the RAMMP Orchestrator. Serves rammp_ui_bridge_interfaces/RequestUserInput and /UpdateUserInputPanel, the single generic mechanism every caller (the Orchestrator's own always-open browse session, or an active engine) uses to push a panel/candidate-object list to UE and receive taps back, and pushes world-state/InteractionPanel updates to UE over its Remote Control WebSocket API. Runs its own rammp_common_interfaces arbitration server (AcquireControl/ReleaseControl/ControlStatus) gating both the shared engine-overlay-camera topic and who currently holds the RequestUserInput goal, so only the currently-active caller's frames/ input requests reach UE.
